notes.title: Huge Update Coming Less Than Two Years Away
notes.notes: Within the next year to two years there will be a major updating coming. I don't want to give too much away, but the levels will more seamlessly flow together, there will be many more world, more enemies, a full story, complete redesign of artwork, new characters, new attacks and unlocks and much more. This will be released all at once and then the following updates will be smaller to fix bugs and provide smaller features. It will all be free to everyone who already bought the game. There won't be paid dlc for these new features.

notes.title: Major Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
- No this game isn't dead!
- Major update coming soon that will massively improve gameplay and make the game fully unique to play. All the levels will still be in it and all the characters will be in it too. Story will remain the same. 
- Major update will be released on Steam and Android. 
- Android version will be free, but with ads. Steam version will stay around $4, but will never have ads. 
- I wish I could give a more exact date, but expect it to be within the next month. 
- I plan on taking the game out of early access after 2/3 of the story is complete. Most likely will be next year in 2024.

notes.title: Stars Update
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug I found not giving out certain stars for sword swinger
Fixed the correct colors for stars
- Gold star is for under 2 minutes
- Red star is for collecting all coins
- Blue star is for taking no damage

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
-fixed music slider not affecting some levels
-fixed UI for most major menus
-Removed cluttered words off UI
-Added Arnaldo Arenas as beta tester in credits
-Changed Pikeman crouch animation
-Added sound for jumping on enemies heads
-Added sound for when killing an enemy
-Fixed World 2 Level 3 not killing Pikeman and Bounty Hunter after falling far enough
-Fixed fireball launchers not firing for Pikeman and Bounty Hunter

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
-Fixed Pikeman not able to kill ranged enemies
-Added bulk buy for axes
-Fixed spot where player could get stuck on World1Level3
-All player projectiles now get destroyed after 1 second so players can't kill enemies far off screen
-Added level ending flags at the end of pits in levels

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
- Player now can't move while crouching
- Increased jump height for all characters
- Fixed player not respawning at right location if they had lives left over
- Changed Pikeman Crouch Animation
- Fixed spots where you could get stuck in different levels
- Can climb hills without needing to jump. Increased slope angle that players can climb

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
-Pikeman has a brand new look 
-Pikeman gain increased attack range 
-Archer has been changed to Bounty Hunter and also has a brand new look
-Increased bounty hunter fire rate, got rid of charge attack, and got rid of knockback on enemies with main attacks
-Jumping on enemy heads now awards XP
-The menu for World 1 now has level 6 and level 4 in order instead of being backwards
-Jump gravity has been increased while maintaining about the same jump height. Jumps will feel more snappy now.
-Fixed Toxic butterflies not being knocked back

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
-Fixed Bog Frog still giving XP after death 
-Fixed typos in lore page
-Fixed scrolling in the lore section
-Added more to archer lore on recommendation from a player 
-Levels will now turn a darker color in the level select menu after beating them

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
- The Sword Swinger has gained a buff to her attack. Her sword now has a much wider area. (Can hit enemies from above, at an angle and directly in front of character. 
- World 2 Level 9 has been released. Boss is at a playable state and level is built.
- Changed compression detail for all textures so they should all appear at full quality now and not be blurry.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: - Audio was all normalized and should be much more equal in levels.

notes.title: Small Update Announcement
notes.notes:
- World 2 Level 9 is halfway complete, but is playable
- Despite what some reviewers may think this game will be finished and will not be left alone
- I thank you for your patience with update times

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
- Loading screen has been updated 
- More images for background of loading screen
- More optimized

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed levels giving error and not opening. (Sorry it took so long to fix)
- Made backgrounds of widgets fully fit screen
- Optimized game

notes.title: Major Performance Update
notes.notes:
- Widget backgrounds will now fully cover the screen
- Total disk size of game is drastically cut down while having no negative effects to gameplay
- Game now uses less ram
- Game now uses less Vram
- Better framerate and now uses Directx11
- Should run better overall now
-  Players can push the down arrow after jumping to fall to ground faster

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
-World 2 Level 7 and 8 added.
-World 2 Level 9 almost complete
-Fixed boss spawning twice in World1Level9
-Added Dialogue for World 1 enemies

notes.title: Performance Update
notes.notes:
Boost to performance on all hardware. 

- AMD FSR is now enabled by default on the Quality preset to boost performance without hurting visuals. 
- Graphics menu is now more easily found in pause menu.
- Graphics menu has settings to change presets of FSR to boost performance even more. 
- Show FPS is in a more easily found spot for graphics settings so you can see affects of changing FSR preset.

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
- Added up to World 2 Level 6
- Some enemies now have dialogue added
- Lots of performance improvements and smaller file size

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed some visual problems
- Fixed fireball launcher not firing
- Fixed random sphere pawn spawning when player spawned

notes.title: Major Update Coming
notes.notes:
The next update will have major additions to the game with new content. You can get new character unlocks and even more characters will be added later on.

You will be able to level up each individual character to unlock the next one or to just see how high of a level you can get to. 

I will also be trying to roll out some new levels and enemies in this update, but the main focus is new playable characters with level up systems.

notes.title: New Content Update
notes.notes:
Features Added:

-Press . or Down on D-pad to auto buy an ax with two coins, instead of opening shop menu.
-World 2 Level 1 and Level 2 and Level 3 are now available to play.
-New Enemies added in World 2.
-New Abilities added for World 2.
-Press Alt or Left Trigger to bring up the tool menu to see all your abilities. 
-Added controls to include every item for controller. 
-Improved some enemies attacks.
-and much more.

Hope you enjoy

notes.title: New Update Coming
notes.notes:
I am proud to announce we will soon be having a new update. This update will add the following and add new things:

- Press the . key to buy axes with 2 coins instead of having to go into the shop menu every time to do it.
- At least world 2 Level 2, but most likely a few more levels too.
- New enemies for World 2.
- New in game purchasable items for the game shop (Won't cost real money).
- New artwork and level designs. 
and much more. Expect this update soon, but keep in mind I am a solo developer working on this project. 
Thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Game Official Release On June 27th, 2022
notes.notes: I am pleased to announce the game will soon be released on June 27th, 2022. It will be released with a 15% discount for the first week, so buy it while it's cheaper. Thank you all for your time and support.
